title: Official blog knowledge stage 1
summary: This iteration adds the data-layer MVP for a curated OpenAI and Anthropic official blog knowledge base. It defines the source-controlled record schema, loader, URL normalization, admission triage, six seed records, and regression coverage for the boundary between durable technical knowledge and ordinary company news.

lessons.lesson: Official company blogs need a durable-knowledge admission gate before they become reusable daily-report context.
lessons.evidence: The stage 1 triage excludes ordinary partnership, customer adoption, funding, hiring, event, award, market, and sales announcements while admitting product, model, agent workflow, eval, MCP, tool-use, context-engineering, safety-engineering, and implementation-practice posts.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep future ingestion stages tied to the same include/exclude/review policy before exposing records on public index pages.

lessons.lesson: Customer stories with technical hints should be reviewed instead of admitted automatically.
lessons.evidence: A regression test now proves that `How ExampleCorp uses Claude for support` with routing, permissions, evaluation harness, observability, and rollout controls returns `needs_review`, while a plain customer-use announcement returns `exclude`.
lessons.recommended_action: Use `needs_review` as the handoff point for later AI-assisted reading instead of treating customer-case wording as direct knowledge-base inclusion.

lessons.lesson: Knowledge records should store Chinese digests and reusable practice notes, not full translations.
lessons.evidence: The schema and loader cap `summary_zh`, require concise `key_ideas` and `practice_checklist`, and reject source records whose summaries look like full-text translations.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep public knowledge pages summary-oriented and link back to canonical sources rather than copying full official posts.

suggestions.issue: The site had no structured, reusable layer for important OpenAI and Anthropic blog posts beyond daily-report mentions.
suggestions.evidence: Stage 1 adds `schemas/official-blog.schema.json`, `src/official-blog-knowledge.js`, six curated seed records, and tests wired into `npm run test`.
suggestions.suggestion: Create a validated official-blog knowledge layer before adding index-page rendering or daily-report cross-linking.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Later stages can generate blog excerpt pages, daily-report links, and trend tracking from a stable contract instead of ad hoc article notes.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented through schema, loader, admission policy, URL normalization, seed records, red/green tests, subagent verification, and arbitration.
validation_evidence: official blog admission triage excludes ordinary customer use announcements
official blog admission triage sends technical customer use framing to review
repository seed knowledge includes curated OpenAI and Anthropic records

followups.action: Stage 2 should add a generated index-page surface and daily-report cross-link metadata without changing the stage 1 admission contract.
Before automatic ingestion, add a second-stage AI reading prompt that classifies previews against this policy and sends technical customer stories to review.
